title: OAB Review Finding
description: One architectural finding. Severity is a function of impact GIVEN ACTUAL SCALE, not of pattern matching — a single database instance is not a finding for a system with no availability target and low traffic. Evidence is mandatory: a finding without a file reference is deleted, not softened.

severity.description: CRITICAL: data loss, breach, or total outage likely under conditions the system will meet soon. HIGH: significant degradation under realistic near-term load, or a one-way door being closed badly. MEDIUM: real risk, conditions not near. LOW: future friction. INFORMATIONAL: observation, no action implied.

evidence.description: file:line references or named configuration facts. Mandatory — this is what separates a finding from an opinion.

context.description: The scale and requirements that make this matter. Findings are weighted by what the system actually does, so the weighting must be visible.

knowledge.description: Knowledge unit ids supporting this finding.

trigger.description: For a finding deliberately not actioned now: the measurable condition that would change that.

scale_independent.description: True for findings that hold at every scale — missing backups, untested restore, unbounded external calls, missing timeouts, no error tracking. Their failure is not proportional to traffic, so they are never downgraded for being a small system.
